headline: Nvidia creates board committee on national security and exports
summary: Nvidia's board established a new standing committee to oversee national security policy, export control compliance and global trade risks, following the Jensen Huang scandal and allegations that Nvidia GPUs were diverted to China. The company said the group aims to avoid a repeat of the issues that led to Huang's departure.
